external.consultation: Opened and read primary Mozilla Urdu localization guide via web tool during this review.
external.applied: Contemporary clear respectful آپ register, consistent terminology, exact external arguments and keyboard shortcuts, Latin numerals, Urdu full stop/comma.
external.limits: Not an official game glossary or proof of disputed 3D/music terminology; individual awkward guide examples are not binding. Bidi punctuation must be rendered, not manually reversed on a guide assertion.

caller_findings.attention_sentence: ValidationPanel.tsx40-44 combines count + translated singular/plural fragment + outer attention template; tested by reading assembled strings.
caller_findings.moderation_imperative: admin/Moderation.tsx104 inserts already complete Disable/Hide imperative into and resolve.
caller_findings.prefixes: AiBuildingStudio.tsx722 concatenates Comparison with before title; Generators.tsx171 concatenates Example of before generator name.
caller_findings.connection_thresholds: Match.tsx245-254 explicitly good under/fair under/poor from threshold.
caller_findings.generic_harvesting: TerrainStudio.tsx770-788 loops every material resource yielding.consumption (one/infinite/whole).
caller_findings.technical_retention: Workspace.tsx431/526/539 are version A/B selectors; Preview.tsx150 execution-sensitive b- prefix; presentation.ts12 Hive product identity.
caller_findings.mute: Player.tsx105 Mute is audio; separate Mute {slot0} moderation key means chat restrictions.

provider_comparison.provider_model: general/nmt (Cloud Translation API; not Google web Advanced)
provider_comparison.source_scope: Eight English context-comparison lines, partly shortened/rephrased; source.txt preserves exact submitted bytes. Not represented as a verbatim full-catalog translation.
provider_comparison.status: actual successful CLI request; no credentials, tokens or HTTP auth logs captured
assessment: Reject provider محفوظ for reserved balances; native and current online مختص correctly expresses allocation.
Provider literal گرم گھنٹیاں and انتظامات do not resolve musical naturalness.
